name: Birushana Senki ~Ichiju no Kaze~
original_name: ビルシャナ戦姫 ～一樹の風～
source: This is the fandisc of Birushana: Rising Flower of Genpei, includes “sweet” after stories that took place after the best endings of each main route, as well as new routes of the sub-characters.
translation: 《毗卢遮那战姬～源平飞花梦想～》的Fan Disc，收录了各条主线最佳结局之后的“甜蜜”后日谈，以及配角们的全新路线。
